description: This file defines the 'StuckGrain' class, which implements the IStuckGrain interface and extends Orleans' Grain class. It includes mechanisms for testing grain activation/deactivation behaviors such as blocking, releasing, counting calls, and handling deactivation events. Additionally, it defines 'StuckCleanupGrain' which interacts with 'StuckGrain' to check activation status and release grains.

classes.name: StuckGrain
classes.description: A grain class designed for testing activation, deactivation, and blocking behaviors.

classes.name: StuckCleanupGrain
classes.description: A grain class that interacts with StuckGrain to release grains and check activation status.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a grain by its Guid key, signaling completion of deactivation or other test scenarios.

methods.name: WaitForDeactivationStart
methods.description: Returns a task that completes when deactivation is signaled to start for a given grain id.

methods.name: SetDeactivationStarted
methods.description: Marks the start of deactivation for a specific grain id by setting an event.

methods.name: BlockCallingTestUntilDeactivation
methods.description: Blocks the calling process until deactivation occurs for the specified grain id.

methods.name: IsActivated
methods.description: Checks if a grain with the given Guid key is active.

methods.name: RunForever
methods.description: Begins an indefinite wait, useful for testing deactivation blocking.

methods.name: NonBlockingCall
methods.description: Increments a call counter for the grain without blocking.

methods.name: GetNonBlockingCallCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the number of non-blocking calls made to the grain.

methods.name: DidActivationTryToStart
methods.description: Checks if an activation attempt has been made on the grain.

methods.name: BlockingDeactivation
methods.description: Marks the grain to block deactivation until explicitly released.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles initialization logic when the grain is activated, including optional delay based on context.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup and logging when the grain is deactivated, with support for blocking deactivation.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a grain by its Guid key using 'StuckGrain'.
